title: Average the endpoints
text: For a linear piece, the integral over that piece is its width times the average of its two endpoint values. Add the pieces.

title: Evaluate
text: The pieces give $$\frac{1\left(2+0\right)}{2}=1$$, $$\frac{2\left(0+5\right)}{2}=5$$, $$\frac{2\left(5+5\right)}{2}=10$$, $$\frac{1\left(5+2\right)}{2}=3.5$$, and $$\frac{2\left(2+0\right)}{2}=2$$. The total is $$21.5=\frac{43}{2}$$.
